title: Scarlet Sails
description: Assol grows up in Kaperna, where people think her strange. Somewhere far away, Captain Gray is searching for what makes life worth living. Two lives that must meet — and a miracle someone has to make with their own hands.
line: A girl was promised a ship with scarlet sails. The whole village laughs — and she waits.
source: after the novella by Alexander Grin
